decision.title: Replace drf-yasg with drf-spectacular, drf-spectacular-sidecar
decision.subject: Closes #9608: Move from drf-yasg to spectacular

prompt: Document the `trace` action of the Interface API viewset in netbox/dcim/api/views.py with drf-yasg's `swagger_auto_schema` decorator (a short description of the response). Keep the change minimal. Do not run any commands or tests.
result: Done. I've added a minimal `@extend_schema` decorator to the `trace` action in the `PathEndpointMixin` class. The decorator includes a brief description of the response ("Trace the cable path from this endpoint to its far end, returning a list of path segments.") and specifies the response type as a list. This follows the existing pattern used for the `elevation` action in the same file.
